answer: Each epoch, agents prove identity by answering a prompt derived from a public randomness beacon, unpredictable until it posts. It forces a fresh reasoning trace weaving arbitrary tokens like river, tide, prism into a task keyed to the agent's wallet. Precomputed templates fail, since words rotate every round. A sybil attacker must run a real, distinct model instance per fake identity each epoch: full compute per puppet plus a staked bond that burns when quality or timing deviates. Cost scales linearly with identities, making bulk fakes unprofitable.
